meta.purpose: Authoritative sources for verifying occupation names in multiple languages for Wikidata bot work

international.name: ISCO-08 (International Standard Classification of Occupations)
international.notes: Base standard for most national classifications. 10 major groups, 43 sub-major, 130 minor, 436 unit groups. Multilingual site at isco-ilo.netlify.app. Full volume PDF in English. French and Spanish versions available. Arabic forthcoming. ILOTERM database has terminology in 7 languages (en/fr/es/de/ru/ar/zh).

international.name: ESCO (European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations)
international.format: CSV, JSON-LD, ODS, RDF, TTL, XML
international.notes: BEST SOURCE for multilingual occupation names. 28 languages: 24 EU official + Icelandic, Norwegian, Ukrainian, Arabic. REST API available. v1.2.1 current. Maps to ISCO-08. Includes skills and competences. Local API installation available.

international.name: UNESCO Thesaurus
international.notes: Controlled vocabulary including occupation terms. 5 languages. SPARQL endpoint available. Covers education, culture, sciences. Not purely occupational but useful for academic/cultural professions.

international.name: ILOTERM Terminology Database
international.notes: ILO's multilingual terminology database. 7 languages. Contains occupation-related terms but not a full classification. Useful for verifying individual occupation names.

international.name: UNSD National Classifications Database
international.notes: META-REGISTRY: 474 classifications from 125 countries. Includes occupation, industry, education classifications. PDF index lists all national classifications by country. Essential for finding lesser-known national standards.

national.name: O*NET-SOC (Occupational Information Network)
national.format: Database download, CSV, XML, Web Services API
national.notes: Most detailed occupational database worldwide. 1016 occupations with skills, knowledge, abilities. REST API available. SOC 2018 has 867 detailed occupations. English only but extremely detailed descriptions.

national.name: SOC 2020 (Standard Occupational Classification)
national.notes: 412 unit groups. 3 volumes: structure, coding index, NS-SEC. CSV downloads available. English only.

national.name: NOC 2021 (National Occupational Classification)
national.notes: Bilingual English/French. 516 unit groups. French titles are native, not translations. Open data portal CSV. Based on ISCO-08.

national.name: ANZSCO 2022 (Australian and New Zealand Standard Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: 1023 occupations at 6-digit level. Joint AU/NZ standard. English only.

national.name: KldB 2010 (Klassifikation der Berufe)
national.notes: Revised 2020 version. 1286 occupational types at 5-digit level. German only. Crosswalk tables to ISCO-08. Maintained by Bundesagentur fur Arbeit.

national.name: ROME 4.0 (Repertoire Operationnel des Metiers et des Emplois)
national.notes: 1584 job cards (growing to ~2000 by 2026). API available via api.gouv.fr. Open data on data.gouv.fr. French only. Maintained by France Travail (ex-Pole Emploi).

national.name: CP2021 (Classificazione delle Professioni)
national.notes: 800 professional units at 5-digit level. CP2021 replaced CP2011. Online navigator with search. Italian only. Based on ISCO-08.

national.name: CNO-11 (Clasificacion Nacional de Ocupaciones)
national.notes: 502 primary groups. Based on ISCO-08. Excel download available from Eustat. Spanish only.

national.name: CPP/2010 (Classificacao Portuguesa das Profissoes)
national.notes: Based on ISCO-08. Published by INE. Portuguese only. PDF download available.

national.name: CBO (Classificacao Brasileira de Ocupacoes)
national.format: ZIP, DOC, online portal, GitHub CSV
national.notes: 2422 occupations. Brazilian Portuguese. GitHub mirror available in CSV. Updated annually. Maintained by Ministry of Labor.

national.name: SINCO 2019 (Sistema Nacional de Clasificacion de Ocupaciones)
national.notes: Mexican national classification. Based on ISCO. Published by INEGI. Spanish only.

national.name: CUOC (Clasificacion Unica de Ocupaciones para Colombia)
national.notes: Based on CIUO-08 A.C. (ISCO adapted for Colombia). 5-digit codes. Published by DANE. Spanish only. 2023 version available.

national.name: CNO 2017 (Clasificador Nacional de Ocupaciones)
national.notes: Published by INDEC. Spanish only. PDF download.

national.name: OKZ OK 010-2014 (Obscherossiyskiy klassifikator zanyatiy)
national.notes: Based on ISCO-08 (MSKZ-08). Russian only. Effective 2015. Multiple download formats. Available from ConsultantPlus, Moscow Open Data.

national.name: DK 003:2010 (Klasyfikator profesiy / Classifier of Professions)
national.notes: Ukrainian only. Based on ISCO-08. Searchable online at Ministry of Economy. XLS download available.

national.name: KZiS (Klasyfikacja Zawodow i Specjalnosci)
national.notes: Polish only. Maintained by GUS and Ministry of Family/Labor. Crosswalk to ISCO-08 available. Updated 2025.

national.name: CZ-ISCO (Czech Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: ~3500 occupations at 5-digit level. Czech and English versions. National open data catalog. Published by Czech Statistical Office.

national.name: FEOR-08 (Hungarian Standard Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: Hungarian and English versions. Published by KSH. Web search interface for FEOR-08 job codes. Effective since 2011.

national.name: COR (Clasificarea Ocupatiilor din Romania)
national.notes: Romanian only. 6-digit codes. Open data in XML format. Published by Ministry of Labour. Based on ISCO-08.

national.name: SBC 2010 / BRC 2014 (Standaard Beroepenclassificatie)
national.notes: Dutch only. SBC replaced by ISCO-08/BRC 2014 since 2013. Application download with search. Published by CBS.

national.name: SSYK 2012 (Standard for svensk yrkesklassificering)
national.notes: Swedish only. Online search tool (SSYK-Sok). Published by SCB. Based on ISCO-08.

national.name: STYRK-08 (Standard for yrkesklassifisering)
national.notes: Norwegian only. API available (JSON/XML/CSV). Open data portal. Published by SSB. Based on ISCO-08.

national.name: DISCO-08 (Danish ISCO)
national.notes: 563 occupations at 6-digit level. Danish adaptation of ISCO-08. Published by Statistics Denmark.

national.name: TK10 / Ammattiluokitus 2010 (Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: Finnish and English. Open API available. CSV and JSON downloads. Published by Statistics Finland. Based on ISCO-08.

national.name: STEP-92 / ISCO-08 Greek adaptation
national.notes: Greek and English. STEP-92 used until 2011, now ISCO-08 at 4-digit level since 2021. Published by ELSTAT.

national.name: ISCO-TR (Turkish Occupation Classification)
national.notes: Turkish adaptation of ISCO-08. Multiple download formats. Published by TUIK.

national.name: SSCO (Saudi Standard Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: Arabic and English. Based on ISCO-08. Published by General Authority for Statistics. Also references Arab Standard Occupational Classification (ASOC).

national.name: Israeli CBS Occupation Classification
national.notes: Hebrew and English. Adjusted to ISCO-08 since 2011. Published by Central Bureau of Statistics.

national.name: NCO 2015 (National Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: 3600 civilian occupations across 53 sectors. Aligned with ISCO-08. Published by DGE, Ministry of Labour. 3 volumes. Primarily English but published by India.

national.name: GB/T 6565-2015 (Classification and codes of occupations)
national.notes: 8 major categories, 75 medium, 434 sub, 1481 occupations. Chinese only. English translation available for purchase (gbstandards.org). Published by SAMR/NBS.

national.name: JSOC Rev.5 (Japan Standard Occupational Classification)
national.notes: Japanese and English versions. 5th revision, December 2009. Published by Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications.

national.name: KSCO 7th (Korean Standard Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: 1231 detailed occupations. 5-level hierarchy. Korean and English. 7th revision (2017). Published by Statistics Korea.

national.name: KBJI 2014 (Klasifikasi Baku Jabatan Indonesia)
national.notes: Indonesian only. Based on ISCO-08. Published by BPS (Central Bureau of Statistics). SIBAKU system provides search. Mobile app available.

national.name: MASCO 2020 (Malaysia Standard Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: Malay and English. 4-digit classification. e-MASCO online portal. Published by Ministry of Human Resources (MOHR).

national.name: PSOC 2012 (Philippine Standard Occupational Classification)
national.notes: Primarily English (official language). Based on ISCO-08 with local modifications. 2022 updates available. Published by PSA.

national.name: TSCO 2001 (Thailand Standard Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: Thai only. Based on ISCO-88. Published by Department of Employment. May be outdated (2001).

national.name: VSCO (Vietnam Standard Classification of Occupations)
national.notes: Vietnamese only. Based on ISCO. Published by General Statistics Office (GSO). Limited online availability. Used in Labor Force Survey at 4-digit level.

national.name: OFO (Organising Framework for Occupations)
national.notes: English only (South Africa has 11 official languages but OFO is in English). Based on ANZSCO structure. Replaced SASCO. Published by DHET.

national.name: Iran Statistical Center Classifications
national.notes: Farsi. Statistical Center of Iran maintains classifications. Limited online availability in English.

open_data_sources.name: Wikidata Occupation Items (P106 values)
open_data_sources.notes: SPARQL query can extract all occupation items with labels in any language. Existing labels are crowdsourced and may have gaps. Query: SELECT ?occ ?label WHERE { ?occ wdt:P31 wd:Q28640 . ?occ rdfs:label ?label . } This IS the target database but also a verification source.

open_data_sources.name: Wiktionary Multilingual
open_data_sources.notes: Category pages per language listing occupation words. Quality varies by language. API access for bulk extraction.

open_data_sources.name: ILO ILOSTAT Occupation Data
open_data_sources.notes: Employment statistics by occupation using ISCO codes. Useful for verifying which occupations exist in which countries.

open_data_sources.name: datasets-br/cbo (GitHub)
open_data_sources.notes: Brazilian CBO in machine-readable CSV format. Community-maintained mirror of official data.

Hausa (ha) - Nigeria NBS uses English
Yoruba (yo) - Nigeria NBS uses English
Igbo (ig) - Nigeria NBS uses English
Bengali (bn) - Bangladesh likely uses ISCO in English
Urdu (ur) - Pakistan likely uses ISCO in English
Sinhala (si) - Sri Lanka uses ISCO-08 in English
Tamil (ta) - No Tamil-language occupation classification found
Cebuano (ceb) - Covered by Philippines PSOC (English)
Javanese (jv) - Covered by Indonesia KBJI (Indonesian)
Minangkabau (min) - Covered by Indonesia KBJI (Indonesian)
Amharic (am) - Ethiopia: no local classification found
Burmese (my) - Myanmar: no local classification found
Khmer (km) - Cambodia: no local classification found
Lao (lo) - Laos: no local classification found
Mongolian (mn) - Mongolia: no local classification found
Nepali (ne) - Nepal: no local classification found
Pashto (ps) - Afghanistan: no local classification found
Georgian (ka) - Georgia: likely uses ISCO adaptation
Armenian (hy) - Armenia: likely uses ISCO adaptation
Azerbaijani (az) - Azerbaijan: likely uses ISCO adaptation

Uzbek (uz) - Uzbekistan: likely uses ISCO/OKZ adaptation

coverage_gaps.recommendation: For languages without national classifications, use: 1) ESCO (28 languages), 2) Wikidata existing labels, 3) Wiktionary, 4) Manual translation from ISCO-08 English labels verified by native speakers.
